ItemID: unavailable; Title: High Hopes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy rock appeal fits, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The River & The Thread; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its roots-oriented songwriting interests me, though I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: After You Should Be So Lucky, I would be interested in hearing more from the Tom Petty circle.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I enjoyed exploring Old Sock, so Clapton playing JJ Cale songs is my strongest pick today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Bad Self Portraits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for familiar blues and rock connections rather than exploring a less familiar act today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: CSNY 1974; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic rock interests me, but I am not ready to commit to a large live collection.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: No Fools, No Fun – 2 Track Bonus Version; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not recognize enough about this release to choose it during a brief visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Dark Side of the Mule; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues-rock connection is appealing, but I would prioritize the Clapton release.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Out Among The Stars; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in Blown Away leaves room for country, but today I am leaning toward blues and rock.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The 1971 Fillmore East Recordings; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Extended blues-rock performances fit my interests, but I would leave this substantial live set for later.
